title: Ezra footer
description: A midnight footer laid out as one full-width row of hairline cells: the co-brand wordmark in the first, then link columns, each under a 34px light serif heading, with 16px cream links on a 32px rhythm and an optional region picker; a tiny centred copyright below. On phones the wordmark centres and each column becomes its own bordered box.
notes: always dark: scopes `dark` and reads the theme's .dark colours
the cell row spans the window edge to edge, as the original
name: ezra-footer

props.name: logo
props.description: the wordmark in the first cell (e.g. an EzraLockup)

props.name: logoLabel
props.description: accessible name of the wordmark link

props.name: columns
props.description: the link columns, one cell each

props.name: copyright
props.description: the tiny line at the bottom ("© 2026 Kestrel")
